description: Create a DXF flat pattern drawing for a sheet metal chassis based on the specifications in '~/Documents/LibreCAD/work_order_001.txt'. Read the file for dimensions and layer requirements. Create the necessary layers (CUT_EXTERIOR, BEND_LINES, CUT_HOLES) with specified colors and line types. Draw the flat pattern geometry including the base, flanges, bend lines, and mounting holes. Save the result to '~/Documents/LibreCAD/chassis_flat_pattern.dxf'.
